description: This is a port of the morph mod to forge 1.16.5

mods.name: Budschie's Morph Mod
mods.description:
This mod is originally a mod with the aim of replacing the metamorph mod
and porting it to 1.16.5. 

Also, one of the goals of this project was/is to make it really compatible
with other mods and allowing other devs to create addons for this mod.

This mod also features data-driven definition of abilities. This enables
mod pack creators to create cool data packs for this mod that either extend already
existing mobs or add compatiblity for added entities of mods.

Currently, you are playing the 1.18.2 version of this mod.
